svg.title: One plan call seen from Dispatch
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram, animated: the planner timer, the request, the scheduler, the checks on the response, the new execution state, command sending and job completion.
svg.metadata: ["Every 850 ms the planner timer asks ShouldCallPlanner: Dispatch is RUNNING, no call is in flight, no job is active (overlapping planning is off), at least one enabled AGV is free, and some pending job is worth planning.", "GetPlannerServiceRequest builds the request: base_state = GetLatest(); base_schedule = every incomplete node and active_jobs = jobs_active_ (both empty today); pending_jobs = queued jobs, capped by the request strategy. The jobs sent are remembered as in flight.", "CallPlanner publishes the request on a topic for bagging and sends it asynchronously. The scheduler runs Plan() synchronously in its service callback and answers.", "PlanClientCallback checks, in order: an execution state exists, the id matches the call in flight, success is true, the execution state has not diverged, every base_schedule node is in the response unchanged, and not every job failed (if more than one was sent).", "A new execution state is built from the response nodes alone: completed nodes are skipped, parents renumbered, AGV src/dst lift and pose fields rewritten from the future state, and every node applied to the future state.", "Per returned job: EXECUTING moves it from pending to active with its node guids to complete; ERROR drops it, or keeps a RETRIEVE (retain_job, or requeued up to 10 times).", "Ready commands go out: an action is sent when its parents are done, it starts within the 30 s command horizon and the safety checker accepts it. AGV moves are chained into one command list.", "Machines report; the garage tracker turns reports into discrete events. Each event completes the matching leading action and advances the latest state. A job whose actions are all complete moves to completed (SUCCESS); when no job is active, the next plan call can happen."]
